cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a night observatory under an open dome — holds a book closed against her chest; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — holds a cup at chest height; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — swimming breaststroke; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing; a starship galley and mess hall — dries her hair with a towel; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — standing; the top of a restored ancient city wall — raises a small red paper lantern beside her face so its glow lights her cheek; an old stone chapel lit by candles — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a small shop — standing
